scope: the six distinct charged J-edge-orbit link fields of claim 1539 on its faithful anomaly-free U(1)^2; the neutral SP--TP orbit coefficient is held as an independent invariant parameter
relationParity: all link fields are assigned even parity, as required for the relation-even Dirac support

renormalizableEnumeration.generalForm: V=sum_i m_i^2 |phi_i|^2 + sum_(i<=j) lambda_ij |phi_i|^2|phi_j|^2 + 2 Re(sum over the 7 quadratic and 76 quartic catalog representatives with independent coefficients), plus a constant
renormalizableEnumeration.completenessRule: enumerate nonnegative holomorphic and antiholomorphic exponent vectors of total degree at most four, retain zero total U(1)^2 charge and nonzero phase vector, and quotient by Hermitian conjugation

continuousRephasingAudit.decision: generic allowed quadratic phase terms already lock every phase direction not generated by U(1)^2; quartics are not needed to remove accidental continuous rephasings

stableVacuumWitness.hessianKernel: exactly the two gauge-orbit tangent directions
stableVacuumWitness.openStableVacuumStatement: the quotient Hessian is nonsingular and positive and det(D16) is nonzero, so sufficiently small coefficient perturbations retain a nearby stable all-nonzero vacuum and full-rank D16

minimalRepeatedChargeIdentification.D16FullRankExample: all six edge Yukawa couplings, all four VEVs and the neutral edge coefficient equal one gives det(D16)=1
minimalRepeatedChargeIdentification.independentYukawaDecision: field identification alone does not equate repeated-charge edge coefficients: independent edge Yukawas y_a,y_b,y_e,y_f can reproduce arbitrary nonzero coefficients from common VEVs
minimalRepeatedChargeIdentification.commonRayDecision: no common Yukawa or Schur ray follows from charge identification
minimalRepeatedChargeIdentification.tiedYukawaDecision: also imposing y_a=y_b and y_e=y_f forces two coefficient equalities; full rank survives at the all-unit point, but those equalities are an additional unsourced alignment and can overconstrain intended independent physical Yukawa/common-ray data

physicalBoundary.finiteLabelResult: SAT: an open stable all-link vacuum with no physical Goldstones and full-rank relation-even D16 exists
physicalBoundary.reason: the finite label charges permit the potential but do not determine its coefficients, identify physical Pati-Salam scalar multiplets, or protect the N--Z--X Schur relation after eliminating the repair sectors

boundary: The neutral edge is treated as a bare invariant coefficient. Promoting it to an additional neutral complex scalar would introduce further allowed cubic and quartic terms and requires a separate parity and accidental-symmetry audit.
